title: Touchscreen & Objects Recognition
shortDescription: A tangible touch table where physical objects unlock digital content in real time. Ideal for playful discovery, learning, and collaborative exploration.
longDescription: Bridge the physical and digital with an interactive touch table that recognizes objects placed on its surface. Each object triggers curated content such as stories, videos, data, or interactive elements, and visitors can touch to dig deeper or combine objects to reveal more. Perfect for exhibitions, brand spaces, and educational settings, it encourages hands-on exploration, shared moments, and intuitive storytelling that feels natural and engaging. BRDGE handles the surface tracking and object recognition, content mapping, scene management, and the links to journey, gallery, and data outputs.

highlights.title: Objects On, Content Up
highlights.description: Set a real object on the table and it instantly calls up its story, video, or data. It is a tangible, intuitive interaction with nothing to hand out and nothing to learn, and it feels a little magical every time.

highlights.title: Made for Hands-On, Together
highlights.description: The shared surface invites several people to explore side by side, touching, placing, and comparing at the same time. That turns solo browsing into a collaborative moment that draws small groups in and keeps them around.

highlights.title: Swap the Objects, Swap the Story
highlights.description: Content is mapped per object, so the same table restocks for a new brand, exhibit, or lesson just by changing the objects and their linked media. One installation covers very different briefs with a low reconfiguration cost.

highlights.title: Sponsor Editions & Extra Tables
highlights.description: Add a sponsor edition with branded objects and rewards, expand from one table to several for larger spaces, or link outcomes into a follow-on module or a post-event reward. New object sets and premium surfaces slot in as paid upgrades.

highlights.title: From Museum Trail to Brand World
highlights.description: Reskin the same table as a museum or education storyline that reveals facts as objects are placed, a seasonal or festive edition, or a branded product world that feels native to the client. The surface and objects stay the same while the look and story change.

highlights.title: Optional Table Data
highlights.description: Add a data layer to log which objects were placed, how often, dwell time per object, and the paths people take across the table, then export it for a post-event read on what drew the most attention.

highlights.title: Part of a Bigger Journey
highlights.description: Pair it with Visitor Identificator to carry each visitor's discoveries across touchpoints, with Journey Manager to make the table one stop on a guided route, or with a Shared Gallery to collect and recap the moments it surfaces.

states.experience: A looping prompt invites people to place an object on the table to see what it unlocks.
states.feedback: Idle visuals, a clear place-here cue, ambient sound.
states.configurable: Attract visuals, branding, demo object set, prompt copy.
states.data: Footfall near the table, attract-to-place conversion.

states.trigger: A recognized object is set on the surface.
states.experience: The table identifies the object and opens its linked content around where it sits.
states.feedback: Recognition halo, object name, a confirming sound.
states.configurable: Recognition method, matched object set, reveal style.
states.data: Objects placed, recognition method used, misreads.

states.trigger: Content is open on the surface.
states.experience: Visitors touch to dig deeper into stories, videos, data, or interactive elements tied to the object.
states.feedback: Touch responses, expanding media, layered detail.
states.configurable: Content per object, depth, layout, language.
states.data: Touches, content opened, dwell time per object.

states.trigger: A second object is added to the surface.
states.experience: The table sets the objects side by side or reveals combined content when certain objects meet.
states.feedback: Comparison view, combination cues, bonus reveals.
states.configurable: Combination rules, compare logic, bonus content.

states.trigger: The objects are removed or the table times out.
states.experience: The surface clears and returns to the attract loop for the next group.
states.feedback: Brief thanks, then a fade back to attract.
states.configurable: Timeout duration, end-screen call to action.
